import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    dim_emp_hist = inputs["dim_emp_hist"]
    asof_queries = inputs["asof_queries"]
    
    # Perform the point-in-time join
    # For each query, find the matching history row where:
    # - emp_id matches
    # - as_of_date >= eff_start_date (start INCLUSIVE)
    # - eff_end_date IS NULL OR as_of_date < eff_end_date (end EXCLUSIVE)
    
    result_rows = []
    
    for _, query_row in asof_queries.iterrows():
        query_id = query_row["query_id"]
        emp_id = query_row["emp_id"]
        as_of_date = query_row["as_of_date"]
        
        # Find matching history rows for this emp_id
        matching_hist = dim_emp_hist[dim_emp_hist["emp_id"] == emp_id]
        
        # Apply the date range conditions
        # Start condition: as_of_date >= eff_start_date
        start_match = as_of_date >= matching_hist["eff_start_date"]
        
        # End condition: eff_end_date IS NULL OR as_of_date < eff_end_date
        end_match = matching_hist["eff_end_date"].isna() | (as_of_date < matching_hist["eff_end_date"])
        
        # Combine both conditions
        valid_rows = matching_hist[start_match & end_match]
        
        # If we have matching rows, take them (there should be at most one valid version)
        # In case of multiple matches (shouldn't happen with proper SCD Type 2),
        # we take all matching rows
        for _, hist_row in valid_rows.iterrows():
            result_rows.append({
                "query_id": query_id,
                "emp_id": emp_id,
                "dept": hist_row["dept"],
                "grade": hist_row["grade"]
            })
    
    # Create result DataFrame
    if result_rows:
        asof_result = pd.DataFrame(result_rows)
    else:
        asof_result = pd.DataFrame(columns=["query_id", "emp_id", "dept", "grade"])
        asof_result = asof_result.astype({
            "query_id": "int64",
            "emp_id": "int64",
            "dept": "str",
            "grade": "str"
        })
    
    return {"asof_result": asof_result}
